text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. Developers often clean up messy code to make it easier to read and understand. Good readability matters because teams spend more time reading code than writing it. Refactoring also helps reduce technical debt, which is the extra work that builds up when quick fixes are chosen over proper solutions. By regularly improving code structure, teams keep their projects healthy and easier to maintain in the future.
